name: MemoryWriteTool
description: 把用户明确要求记住的事实标记为物理证据，由统一 learning.record 流程持久化。

summary.description: The explicit fact the user asked Senera to remember.

until.description: How long the fact remains valid. Defaults to permanent; timestamps must be RFC 3339 with an offset.

sources.Title: Learning record ledger
sources.Description: Learned memory, hierarchical temporal digests, and their physical episode evidence.

search.Summary: 把用户明确要求记住的事实标记为物理证据，由统一 learning.record 流程持久化。

Capabilities.Title: 显式记忆意图
Capabilities.Description: Create physical tool evidence for the completed-turn learner to persist.

UseCases: 用户明确要求记住事实，并给出可选有效期。
Examples: 本次对话记住先给结论
Avoid: 没有用户明确要求时不要调用。
不要自行生成证据索引、置信度或条件 AST。

Projection.SummaryTemplate:
{% for e in evidence %}- evidenceUri: {{ e.evidenceUri }} remember {{ e.slots.summary }} until {{ e.slots.until }}
{% endfor %}

Summary.Template:
{% for block in projections %}{{ block.summary }}
{% endfor %}
Summary.ArtifactTemplate:
{% for block in projections %}{{ block.artifact }}
{% endfor %}
